_note: Italy '43 counters, built by tools/italy-oob/build.py from the set-up card transcriptions. a-d-m are the full-strength side; back is the reduced side ("none" for a one-step counter). Each counter's place in each scenario is under setup.campaign (Campaign Game and Across the Volturno) and setup.bernhard (The Bernhard Line). Values and backs are checked against photos of the counters; backQuality is the troop quality on the reduced side when it differs, and twin links the two sides of a two-sided remnant counter. `estimated` marks a value not seen on a counter.

volturno.name: Across the Volturno
volturno.description: The Fifth Army forces the Volturno, 1 to 16 October 1943.

bernhard.name: The Bernhard Line
bernhard.description: The winter battles for the Bernhard Line, 1 November to 31 December 1943.

campaign.name: Campaign Game
campaign.description: From the Volturno to the Gustav Line, 1 October to 31 December 1943.

German: 26 Pz Div ASU (GE-26Pz-ASU): only its FIRED side appears (Campaign at start 3325, T7 withdraw, T14 return; Bernhard T14 return) - its Ready side and RANGE are unreadable/not shown; range left null (every other division ASU on these cards is range 4).

Full-strength fronts not shown on either card (only the white-striped reduced side appears): III/129/15PG (1-2-5), III/115/15PG (1-2-5), II/1/HG (1-2-5), HG/HG (1-2-6), I/9/26Pz (1-2-5), HG I+II tank (3³-2-5), 71/29PG (4-6-5, thin stripe = 2nd step of a 3-step unit). a-d-m recorded are the reduced values with reduced=true.

Backs not shown for most full-strength units (only I/115, I/29/3PG, 29/3PG III(-) and 215 appear on both sides across the two cards). Backs of e.g. I/129, II/129, 104/15PG, I/2/HG, II/64, the 2-3-5 battalions, the 3-5-3/4-7-3/5-7-3 regiments are unknown.
TQ changes by side: I/115/15PG front 2-3-5 has red (elite) defense but its back 1-2-5 is unboxed; 215 front 4³-3-5 elite, back 2³-2-5 unboxed. Recorded as printed (backQuality null).

Bernhard 'Fortification / No Combat' markers at 2405, 2406, 2508, 2504 (Cassino): read as the reverse 'Under Construction' side of Level 1 forts (18.1.1) - 4 of these + 4 completed 1L = the 8 L1 forts of 18.1.3. Interpretation, not stated on the card.
Tank stacking value: silhouetted tanks print no stacking box; sp=1 recorded per rule 4.3 / Salerno convention.
Bernhard: 26 Pz ASU, I/67, I/9, II/9 and 129/29PG have no at-start position - the card only lists their RETURN (T14 via N3, T19 via N2). Recorded with startBox='withdrawn'.
Bernhard: HG III tank starts in the Eliminated Box (can return only via a Replacement, 20.1).
Campaign: 15PG frozen units' release is conditional (S3.3.3) and has no card turn - not encoded as events.
Place name printed 'Villa Laterno' at 2018 (historically Villa Literno) - recorded as printed.
Division insignia (top-left icons on ASUs) not transcribed.
Allied: Campaign card, recon counters 1 KDG (row 1), 11H/7A (row 1 and Turn 13 REMOVE) and 91 (Turn 9): the art has NO green recon circle on the movement factor 6, while the Bernhard card art for the same three counters has it. All three are recorded as recon, going by the unit-type symbol.
Bernhard card, 505/82 and 325G/82: the card gives no hex, only 'Naples Garrison (S2.3)' (legend: 'May not move'). Start hexes 2024/2124 are taken from the corner hexes printed on the counters.

Corner-number mismatches between appearances of the same counter in the card art: 4 Rgr reads '12' on arrival (Turn 12, and Bernhard 3011) but '11' on the Turn 22 REMOVE art (both cards); 7 Arm Div ASU reads '2' on arrival and on Bernhard 2014 but '2527' on the Turn 17 REMOVE art; 3 Div ASU reads '2' on Turn 2 arrival but '2927' on the Turn 19 REMOVE art. The scheduled turns/hexes are not affected.

Reduced (striped) sides print stacking value 3, not 2: 128/46, 138/46, 139/46, 167/56, 169/56 (3-5-3), 7/3 (4-5-3), 157/45 and 179/45 (4-4-3). 133/34's last step 1-3-3 prints 2. Salerno counters used backSp 2, so check the physical counters.
Heavy howitzer M1 (Turn 18 Naples): no range and no stacking box printed. Range is recorded as null and sp as 0 (from rule 19.4). The counter has no formation marking.
Silhouetted tank/TD counters print no stacking value; sp is recorded as null (4.3: the first is free, each other one counts 1).

Remnants: only the Bernhard card lists them (BR 'A' x3, 22/7A x1, US 'A' x3, 82 x1, FR 'A' x2). The campaign card does not show them; S3.1 says 'Remnants ... are all available from the start'. Each type is one entry with a count, and the lettering of the other copies (B/C?) is unknown.
French remnant (Bernhard remnant display): it has the mountain symbol and a dark 2M-coloured box. It is recorded as type mountain, formation 2M Div, at medium confidence.
Bernhard card air/naval markers: the card says only 'Place in Holding Box' and gives no side. The campaign card says 'on their Used side'.
Bernhard 760 at '2124 / Naples' (italic): recorded as a normal start in Naples hex 2124, not as garrison. It is outside the white garrison frame and S2.3 does not name it.
Most counters appear on their front side only, so their backs (reduced values) are unknown. back/backSp are filled only where a card shows the reduced side.
I Mtr formation: the counter has no '/formation' suffix, so it is recorded as its own formation 'I Mtr'.
